hostname.description: The hostname to use. Defaults to "192.168.1.1".

password.description: The password to use. Defaults to "".

port.description: The port to use. Defaults to 80.

scheme.description: The URI scheme to use. Defaults to "http".

username.description: The username to use. Defaults to "root".

block.description: Interfaces with an OpenWrt device through LuCI RPC. See https://github.com/openwrt/luci/wiki/JsonRpcHowTo#basics for setup instructions.

dhcpv4.description: The mode of the DHCPv4 server. Must be one of: "disabled", "server".

dhcpv6.description: The mode of the DHCPv6 server. Must be one of: "disabled", "relay", "server".

force.description: Forces DHCP serving on the specified interface even if another DHCP server is detected on the same network segment.

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

ignore.description: Specifies whether dnsmasq should ignore this pool.

interface.description: The interface associated with this DHCP address pool. This name is what the interface is known as in UCI, or the `id` field in Terraform. Required if `ignore` is not `true`.

leasetime.description: The lease time of addresses handed out to clients. E.g. `12h`, or `30m`. Required if `ignore` is not `true`.

limit.description: Specifies the size of the address pool. E.g. With start = 100, and limit = 150, the maximum address will be 249. Required if `ignore` is not `true`.

ra.description: The mode of Router Advertisements. Must be one of: "disabled", "relay", "server".

ra_flags.description: Router Advertisement flags to include in messages. Must be one of: "home-agent", "managed-config", "none", "other-config".

start.description: Specifies the offset from the network address of the underlying interface to calculate the minimum address that may be leased to clients. It may be greater than 255 to span subnets. Required if `ignore` is not `true`.

block.description: Per interface lease pools and settings for serving DHCP requests.

authoritative.description: Force dnsmasq into authoritative mode. This speeds up DHCP leasing. Used if this is the only server on the network.

domain.description: DNS domain handed out to DHCP clients.

domainneeded.description: Never forward queries for plain names, without dots or domain parts, to upstream nameservers.

ednspacket_max.description: Specify the largest EDNS.0 UDP packet which is supported by the DNS forwarder.

expandhosts.description: Never forward queries for plain names, without dots or domain parts, to upstream nameservers.

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

leasefile.description: Store DHCP leases in this file.

local.description: Look up DNS entries for this domain from `/etc/hosts`.

localise_queries.description: Choose IP address to match the incoming interface if multiple addresses are assigned to a host name in `/etc/hosts`.

localservice.description: Accept DNS queries only from hosts whose address is on a local subnet.

readethers.description: Read static lease entries from `/etc/ethers`, re-read on SIGHUP.

rebind_localhost.description: Allows upstream 127.0.0.0/8 responses, required for DNS based blocklist services. Only takes effect if rebind protection is enabled.

rebind_protection.description: Enables DNS rebind attack protection by discarding upstream RFC1918 responses.

block.description: A lightweight DHCP and caching DNS server.

ip.description: The IP address to be used for this domain.

ip.description: The IP address to be used for this host, or `ignore` to ignore any DHCP request from this host.

mac.description: The hardware address(es) of this host, separated by spaces.

block.description: Assign a fixed IP address to hosts.

leasetrigger.description: Location of the lease trigger script.

dadtransmits.description: Amount of Duplicate Address Detection probes to send

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

name.description: Name of the device. This name is referenced in other network configuration.

ports.description: Specifies the wired ports to attach to this bridge.

type.description: The type of device. Currently, only "bridge" is supported.

ula_prefix.description: IPv6 ULA prefix for this device.

block.description: Contains interface-independent options affecting the network configuration in general.

auto.description: Specifies whether to bring up this interface on boot.

device.description: Name of the (physical or virtual) device. This name is what the device is known as in LuCI or the `name` field in Terraform. This is not the UCI config name.

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

ip6assign.description: Delegate a prefix of given length to this interface

macaddr.description: Override the MAC Address of this interface.

mtu.description: Override the default MTU on this interface.

proto.description: The protocol type of the interface. Currently, only "dhcp, and "static" are supported.

reqaddress.description: Behavior for requesting address. Can only be one of "force", "try", or "none".

reqprefix.description: Behavior for requesting prefixes. Currently, only "auto" is supported.

enable_mirror_rx.description: Mirror received packets from the `mirror_source_port` to the `mirror_monitor_port`.

enable_mirror_tx.description: Mirror transmitted packets from the `mirror_source_port` to the `mirror_monitor_port`.

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

mirror_monitor_port.description: Switch port to which packets are mirrored.

mirror_source_port.description: Switch port from which packets are mirrored.

name.description: Name of the switch. This name is what is shown in LuCI or the `name` field in Terraform. This is not the UCI config name.

description.description: A human-readable description of the VLAN configuration.

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

ports.description: A string of space-separated port indicies that should be associated with the VLAN. Adding the suffix `"t"` to a port indicates that egress packets should be tagged, for example `"0 1 3t 5t"`.

vid.description: The VLAN tag number to use.

vlan.description: The VLAN "table index" to configure. This index corresponds to the order on LuCI's UI

conloglevel.description: The maximum log level for kernel messages to be logged to the console.

cronloglevel.description: The minimum level for cron messages to be logged to syslog.

hostname.description: A short single-line description for the system.

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

log_size.description: Size of the file based log buffer in KiB.

notes.description: Multi-line free-form text about the system.

timezone.description: The POSIX.1 time zone string. This has no corresponding value in LuCI. See: https://github.com/openwrt/luci/blob/cd82ccacef78d3bb8b8af6b87dabb9e892e2b2aa/modules/luci-base/luasrc/sys/zoneinfo/tzdata.lua.

ttylogin.description: Require authentication for local users to log in the system.

zonename.description: The IANA/Olson time zone string. This corresponds to "Timezone" in LuCI. See: https://github.com/openwrt/luci/blob/cd82ccacef78d3bb8b8af6b87dabb9e892e2b2aa/modules/luci-base/luasrc/sys/zoneinfo/tzdata.lua.

block.description: Provides system data about an OpenWrt device

band.description: Channel width. Must be one of: "2g", "5g", "6g".

cell_density.description: Configures data rates based on the coverage cell density. Must be one of 0, 1, 2, 3.

channel.description: The wireless channel. Currently, only "auto" is supported.

htmode.description: Channel width. Must be one of: "HE20", "HE40", "HE80", "HE160", "HT20", "HT40", "HT40-", "HT40+", "NONE", "VHT20", "VHT40", "VHT80", "VHT160".

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

type.description: The type of device. Currently only "mac80211" is supported.

block.description: The physical radio device.

device.description: Name of the physical device. This name is what the device is known as in LuCI/UCI, or the `id` field in Terraform.

encryption.description: Encryption method. Currently, only PSK encryption methods are supported. Must be one of: "none", "psk", "psk2", "psk2+aes", "psk2+ccmp", "psk2+tkip", "psk2+tkip+aes", "psk2+tkip+ccmp", "psk+aes", "psk+ccmp", "psk-mixed", "psk-mixed+aes", "psk-mixed+ccmp", "psk-mixed+tkip", "psk-mixed+tkip+aes", "psk-mixed+tkip+ccmp", "psk+tkip", "psk+tkip+aes", "psk+tkip+ccmp", "sae", "sae-mixed".

id.description: Name of the section. This name is only used when interacting with UCI directly.

isolate.description: Isolate wireless clients from each other.

key.description: The pre-shared passphrase from which the pre-shared key will be derived. The clear text key has to be 8-63 characters long.

mode.description: The operation mode of the wireless network interface controller.. Currently only "ap" is supported.

network.description: Network interface to attach the wireless network. This name is what the interface is known as in UCI, or the `id` field in Terraform.

ssid.description: The broadcasted SSID of the wireless network. This is what actual clients will see the network as.

wpa_disable_eapol_key_retries.description: Enable WPA key reinstallation attack (KRACK) workaround. This should be `true` to enable KRACK workaround (you almost surely want this enabled).
